top_choice_rationale: P002 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) anchors the prize in what was discovered about GLP-1: the incretin effect in humans, proglucagon-derived peptide biology, and characterization of the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, with incretin therapy for diabetes and obesity as the independently confirmed consequence. Mojsov's priority against the Habener group is unresolved, so the citation should rest on peptide characterization, not first discovery of the hormone. P001 is a close second because Knudsen's protraction chemistry removed the half-life obstacle; no award is clearly worse than either given the mature, confirmed science.
